environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; thick, fibrous bark with chunky, rounded textures; needles appear as soft, clustered tufts; emphasis on the massive, ancient scale of the trunks; avoiding sharp or aggressive angles.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle view looking up at the base of a massive Taxodiaceous conifer. The trunk is broad and buttressed, disappearing into a thick canopy above. Ferns cluster tightly around the root flares.
visual_logic.ground: Dark, rich peat and silty grey mud, heavily littered with fallen needles and botanical debris.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; direct sunlight filtering through the upper needles, creating dramatic 'god-rays' and high-contrast highlights on the textured bark.
